description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods for language models. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with the names Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 GB, with tick labels at intervals of 20 GB. Each category is represented by a bar, with the first five categories colored orange and the last category, "Ours", colored green. The bar heights vary, with "Full FT" being the tallest at approximately 70 GB, and "QLoRA" being the shortest at around 10 GB. The other bars have heights of approximately 40 GB for "MTL-FT", 20 GB for both "TAG" and "LoRA", and 20 GB for "Ours". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the green bar for "Ours" is visually distinct from the other orange bars.
